title: PackageRegistration
description: One learner package attempt pinned to a course release and package version.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

institution_id.description: Institution owning these data and their access policy.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

enrollment_id.description: Enrollment whose effective release authorizes this registration.
enrollment_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

enrollment_release_id.description: Exact release at assignment and launch.
enrollment_release_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

activity_version_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

package_version_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

placement_id.description: Course occurrence scoped to effective release.
placement_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

organization_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

attempt_number.description: Ordinal among learner registrations for this placement and assigned version.

runtime_policy_revision.description: Immutable mapping from package state to native evidence.

total_time_ms.description: Exact fixed-unit millisecond projection only when duration has no unresolved calendar components.

active_launch_session_id.description: Current authoritative launch session if any.
active_launch_session_id.x-reference-scope: Session belongs to this exact registration and epoch.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state advanced only through owner commands.

duration_total.description: Lossless duration sum. Preserve calendar components separately from fixed elapsed units.

x-invariants: Single writer epoch. No evidence accepts a stale grant.
Package, organization and source placement remain pinned.
Runtime state and learner grade evidence remain separate.
